claim: Shared suggestions require an explicit attributed accept or reject decision without applying proposal text before acceptance.
verified: Human and model proposals retain author, display-name, timestamp, source revision, and provider/model/run provenance
Decisions retain reviewer attribution and name the exact proposal event
Exact replay is idempotent and stale or reused identities fail before mutation
Disconnected opposite decisions are both retained and project an explicit conflict
Disconnected proposal-root identity collisions and hostile bucket mutations fail closed
Proposal and decision writes do not change existing policy text
The editor node, semantic marker, and immutable version retain only stable suggestion identity
Pending, accepted, rejected, conflicted, and missing states are visible without a model
MCP research-state inspection exposes bounded status/provenance metadata while omitting proposal and decision bodies
Production TypeScript and Vite build passes
limitations: Accept records the review decision but does not yet apply proposal text to the policy; revision-guarded application remains P-24.
Installation researcher identity is caller-supplied and is not authenticated.
Packaged physical two-client pointer interaction and Drive-backed convergence are not yet proven.
No model generation or MCP suggestion-mutation tool is included in this slice.
